newsitem.title: UK: Canadian mine seeks London AIM market listing.
newsitem.headline: Canadian mine seeks London AIM market listing.

text.p: Canadian firm Zicor Mining Inc said on Monday it applied for a listing on the Alternative Investment Market of the London Stock Exchange.
Trading in the shares of the junior exploration firm is expected to start on February 11.
The company said it had placed 4.72 million shares at 18 pence per share to raise 850,000 stg before expenses to negotiate acquisition opportunities in gold and base metals mining.
Zicor, which is already listed on the Vancouver stock exchange, also wants to complete the acquisition of a business trading in ore and concentrates.
